scope_authorization.user_request_verbatim: 确认下一步的开发计划并执行
scope_authorization.interpretation: Execute the next bounded R07-C P-A preparation after confirming previous delivery; this is not specific acceptance of the new policy.

option_a.predicate: Only the existing placeholder assignment after both original Conda omission returns, nonempty matched rest, failed existing VERSION fullmatch and failed existing RANGE fullmatch.
option_a.mutation: Add internal Literal member and setdefault at that existing branch only; retain regexes, diagnostics, specifier, exact, append and all current consumption.
explicit_costs: Known nonexact forms and unrelated noncritical entries may conservatively SKIP all remaining currently used uncredited critical packages repository-wide.
An isolated WARNING or promoted CRITICAL threshold may change exit 1 to 0.
Default text may show PASS with skips; default export may lose a notable warning; complete JSON retains SKIP.
This grants no exact credit, validity, completeness, installation or reproducibility certificate.

option_b: Do not apply patches; retain captured-view WARNING and the remaining open extraction boundary.
forbidden: new Conda grammar or manager/solver execution
restoring exact credit or inferring package use
engine, scanner, redaction, persisted schema, dependencies or version changes
release, paid API, GPU, Hub, external issue or application submission
